Five fluffy white ducks stand together in shallow, rippling water, facing the viewer with oversized green eyes and broad orange bills. At the back left, one wears a red knit hat trimmed with thick white fur and stares straight ahead. In the center, a duck in a dark blue patterned hat holds its bill wide open. Behind them on the right, another wears a multicolored knit hat and black sunglasses. A fourth duck stands in front wearing a red hat with a white fur brim, its bill partly open. At the front right, the fifth wears a bright pom-pom hat and a blue hoodie with red lettering, its wings tucked into the hoodie’s pockets. Dark water fills most of the background, with a soft band of brown grasses along the far shore.
